cli.about: Steam Manifest Downloader — terminal UI and headless CLI
cli.longAbout:
Without a command, opens the interactive terminal UI (mouse and keyboard).
The commands below run without a UI, for servers, containers and scripts.
Settings, history and caches are shared with the desktop app.
cli.argDataDir: Data directory (settings, history, caches). Defaults to the desktop app's directory so both share their state.
cli.argVerbose: Show the backend's diagnostic output on stderr instead of writing it to the log file (headless commands only).
cli.cmdTui: Open the interactive terminal UI (default when started in a terminal).
cli.cmdDownload: Download depots from a .lua/.st file or an App ID.
cli.cmdSearch: Look up a game by name, or list the sources and depots for an App ID.
cli.argSource: A .lua / .st depot file, or a numeric Steam App ID to look up in the configured depot sources.
cli.argDepots: Depot IDs to download (comma separated). Default: the depots Steam would install (see --all-depots).
cli.argOut: Parent folder for the game folder. Default: the download location from the settings.
cli.argMhKey: ManifestHub API key, used as fallback (and for custom manifests).
cli.argResult: Which search result to use when SOURCE is an App ID (see `smd search`).
cli.argManifest: Pin a depot to a specific manifest: DEPOT=MANIFEST (repeatable).
cli.argUpdate: Update an existing download in place: only changed files are downloaded and files removed from the game are deleted.
cli.argSpeedLimit: Limit the download speed, e.g. 10MB/s or 75Mbit/s (built-in downloader only). Default: the speed limit from the settings, 0 for unlimited.
cli.argShutdown: Shut down the computer when the download has finished. Waits 60 seconds first, Ctrl+C aborts. Not done when the download is interrupted.
cli.argList: Only print the depots that would be downloaded.
cli.argJson: Print progress events as JSON lines (stdout contains only JSON).
cli.argQuery: Steam App ID, or a game name to look up the App ID.
cli.argManifests: Also list the depots of this search result.
cli.appNotFoundResult: App {app} not found in any configured depot source (result #{n})
cli.noMainAppId: The file does not name a main App ID
cli.noDepots: none of the requested depots exist
cli.shutdownIn: Shutting down in 60 s, press Ctrl+C to abort.
cli.mhHint: hint: pass a ManifestHub key with --mh-key <KEY> or SMD_MANIFESTHUB_KEY
cli.appNotFound: App {app} was not found in any configured depot source.
cli.noTerminal: the terminal UI needs an interactive terminal — use `smd download` / `smd search` in scripts (see `smd --help`)
cli.runtimeFailed: failed to start the async runtime: {message}
cli.helpCommand: Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)
cli.argIgnoreSpace: Start even when the download location does not have enough free space.
cli.noSpace: not enough disk space: the download needs about {needed}, but only {free} is free at {path} (use --ignore-space to start anyway)
cli.argRepair: With --update: check every file against the installed version and download only damaged or missing parts, without updating.
cli.argAllDepots: Download every depot in the file instead of picking them like Steam.
cli.argPlatform: Platform to pick depots for when choosing like Steam. Default: this system, or Windows when the game has no build for it.
cli.argLanguage: Game language to pick depots for, as Steam names it (for example german, english, french). Default: the app language.
cli.autoSelectFailed: Could not read the depot list from Steam, so every depot is downloaded: {message}
